onenight.title: Une nuit
onenight.kicker: One night ashore · pick the quarter you are berthed nearest · in the order you go
onenight.lede: Split eats at the southern hour: kitchens fill from about eight and most take last orders between ten and eleven. Each quarter below is one evening on foot — the walk or the glass, the table, the last look — and every quarter is ten minutes or less from the Riva. Hours were re-checked on 23 October 2026; where listings disagree, the step says call.
onenight.door_en: Crew ashore for one evening: a plan for each quarter — the palace, Varoš, the harbour, the centre, the sea at Firule — in the order you go.
onenight.door_note: L’apéro · la table · le dernier verre

quarters.name: The palace · the Peristyle and its lanes
quarters.line: The emperor's courtyard as the day visitors leave, a counter that cooks the morning's market, and the sphinx at night.

steps.name: The palace at dusk
steps.text: In by the Golden Gate and down to the Peristyle as the groups go back to the ships; take a side lane, not the main cardo.

steps.name: Villa Spiza
steps.text: The small counter on Kružićeva: the fish on the board, a black risotto, the chocolate cake. No bookings and cash only; on its winter hours it serves until 22:00 and shuts on Sundays, so come early.

steps.name: The sphinx on the Peristyle
steps.text: Back to the Peristyle when the terraces have packed up: the black granite sphinx, the columns, and the stone holding the day's warmth.

quarters.after: Upstairs instead: [[venue:v06-apetit|Apetit]], in a Gothic palace on Šubićeva, for pašticada with homemade pasta; listed open to midnight, call in winter.

quarters.name: Veli Varoš · the fishermen's quarter
quarters.line: Stone lanes climbing to the hill, the catch shown on a plate before you choose it, and a bottle at the harbour.

steps.name: Veli Varoš
steps.text: Up the steps from the west end of the Riva into the stone houses and stairs below Marjan, on the way to dinner.

steps.name: Konoba Fetivi
steps.text: The black cuttlefish risotto, then a fish chosen from the plate, or the gregada when there is one. Listed 12:00–23:00; the closing day differs by listing (Sunday or Monday), so book and confirm.

steps.name: Matejuška with a bottle
steps.text: Down to the fishermen's harbour to sit on the stone with the boats; mind the city's fine for drinking in public.

quarters.after: Next door instead: [[venue:v08-konoba-matejuska|Konoba Matejuška]] for its wine-marinated tuna (not re-confirmed for 2026: call), [[venue:v11-sperun|Šperun]] for grilled sardines, or [[venue:v09-konoba-marjan|Konoba Marjan]], a few tables on Senjska — book, the dishes sell out by half past seven.

quarters.name: The Riva and the harbour front
quarters.line: The palace's sea face lit up, then the city's first starred counter, a few minutes west.

steps.name: The Riva
steps.text: The waterfront below the palace's south wall, from the Prokurative east, when the city comes out to walk.

steps.name: Krug
steps.text: The five- or nine-course menu at the twelve-seat counter facing the open kitchen. Book well ahead; its hours and winter schedule are not published, so confirm the date when you do.

quarters.after: Spend it on the terrace instead: [[venue:v01-zoi|ZOI]], behind the unmarked door on the Riva, dinner only, book. Cheaper: [[venue:v10-fife|Buffet Fife]] at Matejuška, walk-in, pašticada and fried squid.

quarters.name: The centre · Marulićeva to Marmontova
quarters.line: A Croatian glass in a narrow street, octopus by the fish hall, and ćevapi from the window to finish.

steps.name: Zinfandel
steps.text: A glass of Pošip or a Tribidrag from Kaštela at the MICHELIN-listed bistro on Marulićeva; its listed hours disagree (some say closed Sunday, some Monday), so look in first.

steps.name: Bokeria Kitchen & Wine
steps.text: Round the corner on Domaldova, by the fish hall: the octopus, with a bottle chosen from the walls. Reserve, even off-season.

steps.name: Kantun Paulina
steps.text: If anyone is still hungry: ćevapi in a soft lepinja with ajvar and onion, from the window on Matošića. Listed to 23:00 by one guide and not re-confirmed for 2026; cash only.

quarters.name: Bačvice and Firule · the sea to the east
quarters.line: The city's sand beach at sunset, then the garden terrace over the open channel.

steps.name: Bačvice
steps.text: Ten minutes east from the Riva, past the ferry port, for the last light on the sand; the sea is cooling from about 19°C now.

steps.name: Dvor
steps.text: The ceviche of fish, scampi and scallops, then a whole grilled fish or the brodet, on the terrace facing the islands. Dvor has historically closed for a winter break: call before you walk over.

quarters.after: The quarter itself, and when to come: [[card:Bačvice and Firule|Bačvice and Firule]].

getaway.title: Le week-end
getaway.door_en: Friday night to Sunday afternoon: a terrace on the Riva, the palace at dawn, both markets, a twelve-seat counter, Marjan, and Meštrović's house.
getaway.door_note: Le palais · le marché · le comptoir · la colline
getaway.kicker: The getaway weekend · Friday night to Sunday afternoon
getaway.lede: Split sells itself as a ferry port and a film set. The real weekend is the palace before anyone else is up, and the town that still shops at its gates: the green market and the fish hall in the morning, a counter that cooks the market, the hill above it all, and the city's first starred table at night. Friday on the Riva; Saturday the palace at dawn, the markets, the emperor's cellars, Marjan and Krug; Sunday Meštrović and the fishermen's buffet. It is built for late October and November, when the ships thin out. Every stop below is already in this guide and was re-checked on 23 October 2026; where a place could not be re-confirmed, the stop says so. All of it is on foot.
book: [[venue:v-krug|Krug]] — about twelve seats: book well ahead, and confirm the date (its winter schedule is not published).
[[venue:v01-zoi|ZOI]] — booking essential, directly with the restaurant; dinner only, and it publishes no winter schedule.
[[venue:v12-villa-spiza|Villa Spiza]] takes no bookings: arrive early, with cash.

days.label: Friday
days.title: The Riva and a terrace above it

stops.name: The Riva at dusk
stops.text: Walk the waterfront below the palace's south wall as the lights come on and the island ferries leave.

stops.name: Dinner at ZOI
stops.text: Through the unmarked door in the palace wall and up to the top-floor terrace for the tasting menu: the raw tuna smoked to order, the Brač lamb.
stops.meta: Obala hrvatskog narodnog preporoda 23 · dinner from about 18:00 on Fridays (listings) · book (checked 23 Oct 2026)

days.label: Saturday
days.title: The palace, the markets, the hill and the counter

stops.name: Through the palace, gate to gate
stops.ref: card:Through the palace, gate to gate
stops.text: In at the Golden Gate, down to the Peristyle, out through the Bronze Gate to the Riva, while the lanes still belong to the people who live in them.
stops.meta: Golden Gate · about 1 hour 45 with stops · free

stops.name: The Pazar
stops.text: The green market against the east wall: dried figs, Pag cheese, the new oil if it is in. Not re-confirmed for 2026 against a dated source, but it trades daily.
stops.meta: Silver Gate · daily from about 06:00 to early afternoon (listings differ) · cash

stops.name: The Ribarnica
stops.text: A few minutes west, the night's catch sold by weight; look, or buy for the galley.
stops.meta: Kraj Sv. Marije, off Marmontova · mornings, closes about 13:00 · cash

stops.name: The substructures
stops.text: Under the palace, the vaulted cellars that kept the plan of the rooms above them.
stops.meta: Enter from the Riva through the Bronze Gate · paid (Oct 2026 listings)

stops.name: The cathedral and its bell tower
stops.ref: card:The cathedral and its bell tower
stops.text: The emperor's tomb turned into the city's cathedral, then the climb for the roofs of the palace and the islands.
stops.meta: On the Peristyle · hours shorten from November, check at the ticket desk

stops.name: Lunch at Villa Spiza
stops.text: Whatever fish is on the board, the black risotto, the chocolate cake. Walk in, early.
stops.meta: Kružićeva 3 · winter Tue–Sat 13:00–22:00 (guides, undated) · no bookings, cash only

stops.name: Marjan
stops.text: Up the steps from Varoš to Vidilica in fifteen minutes, then on round the hill through the pines for the last hour of light over the islands.
stops.meta: Start at the top of Veli Varoš · about 2 hours for the loop · free

stops.name: Dinner at Krug
stops.text: The nine-course menu at the counter, the kitchen in front of you: the table that won Split its first MICHELIN star, in the 2025 guide.
stops.meta: Obala Ante Trumbića 17 · hours not published · book well ahead (checked 23 Oct 2026)

days.label: Sunday
days.title: The sculptor and the fishermen's buffet

stops.name: D16 Coffee
stops.text: A filter coffee from Split's own roaster in a dim palace lane.

stops.name: Galerija Meštrović
stops.text: The sculptor's house and garden at the foot of Marjan, and the chapel of his wooden reliefs on the same ticket.
stops.meta: Šetalište Ivana Meštrovića 46 · Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 · about 15 minutes on foot west of the centre

stops.name: Lunch at Buffet Fife
stops.text: Back along the water to Matejuška for pašticada with gnocchi, or fried squid if the pašticada has gone.
stops.meta: Trumbićeva obala 11 · listed daily, all year · walk in

stops.name: Bačvice
stops.text: East past the ferry port to the city's sand beach for a last walk on the water, or a cold swim for the hardy.
stops.meta: About 10 minutes east of the Riva · free

more.title: If you have only one evening
more.text: Go to Varoš: [[venue:v04-konoba-fetivi|Konoba Fetivi]] for the black risotto and the fish of the day, then the harbour at [[card:Matejuška with a bottle|Matejuška]].

more.title: The grand night instead
more.text: [[venue:v03-dvor|Dvor]], at Firule, on the terrace over the open channel — but it has historically closed for a winter break, so call before you plan round it.

more.title: This October and November
items: The olive harvest and the first new oil on Brač and Šolta: [[card:The olive harvest and the new oil, Brač and Šolta|the new oil]].
The island ferries are on low-season times until the end of the year: [[card:The island boats on low-season times|check the last boat]].
Hajduk are listed at home on 21 and 28 November, times to confirm: [[card:Hajduk at Poljud, 21 and 28 November|Hajduk at Poljud]].
Advent and the fritule are expected from 28 November (unofficial dates): [[card:Advent in Split, end of November to 6 January|Advent in Split]].

more.title: Where to sleep
more.text: This guide judges tables, not rooms, and names no hotel. Stay within walking distance of the Riva and every stop above is on foot.

more.title: What we would leave out
more.text: The [[card:The laminated menu in the palace|photograph menus in the palace]], the [[card:The pitcher of house wine|unlabelled jug wine]], and the palace at midday on [[card:The cruise-day midday|a cruise day]].
